Single Speed 26" Vintage Lowrider Cruiser Bike - Simple, Elegant and Efficient
The Tracer Cheetah 26" Chrome Vintage Stretch Cruiser Bike combines timeless design with modern functionality. Its sleek chrome frame not only delivers an eye-catching, polished finish but also offers durability and resistance to rust. Built with a stretched frame and classic cruiser geometry, this lowrider bike ensures a comfortable, laid-back riding experience. The single-speed setup simplifies maintenance while providing smooth cruising on flat terrain. With wide, 26-inch tires for added stability and a vintage-inspired silhouette, the Tracer Cheetah is perfect for riders seeking a stylish, retro ride that's both reliable and easy to handle.

WEIGHT

The most accurate way to determine any bike’s weight is to have your local dealer weigh it for you. Many brands strive to list the lowest possible weight, but in reality weight can vary based on size, finish, hardware and accessories. All our bikes are designed for best-in-class weight and ride quality.
